Each observation is corrected once; a fit updates only subsequent variances while retaining the streamed subspace belief. Known coordinate changes are aligned before block fitting. The three orthographic spheres share a density scale; panel (b) of the following density page shows the physical-query risk at all three checkpoints, $v_t^T(M_t^--(M_t^-)^2)v_t$ at the recorded physical query. This is individual belief uncertainty, distinct from the repeated-episode variance bands and from calibration. Empirical-Bayes plug-in scales omit their uncertainty and are outside the fixed-true-variance theorem.

Contact observations are real. On the appended size pages, panels (a), (b), (c) show the state-ball chordal radius, clean scalar width and noisy scalar width, respectively. These are 128 independent test episodes per fixed checkpoint and regime.

supp_variance_prediction_cost.pdf.proposed_latex_caption: Fixed-boundary stationary-block EM reference. Every E-step reconstructs the full block from one saved boundary prior. Evidence curves are shifted by their own initial value, so final heights do not rank starts; absolute normalized evidence selects starts. Both positive starts and the uniform-prior zero-signal boundary are retained. Noise floors and pooled isotropic M-steps are tested in the numerical tables. Contact residual updates include posterior response uncertainty, not only a squared residual using the mean projector. These reference blocks are not online adaptive-tracker episodes. Actual causal variance learning from completed nonoverlapping past blocks. Each observation is corrected once; a fit updates only subsequent variances while retaining the streamed subspace belief. Known coordinate changes are aligned before block fitting. Curves show saved trajectory/episode summaries; variance bands are interquartile repeated-episode spread, not a posterior over variance. Future-task and pre-observation score intervals are pointwise 95\% intervals across independent episodes. Each page retains one predeclared noise-, motion-, or signal-power intervention. All intervals are evaluated at their declared time before the scored future observation is seen. Appended pages show 95% report-size distributions at t=64 for every probability regime. Phase stacks sum per-phase medians and need not equal median total elapsed time.
